supported_claims: The encounter review workspace renders the note alongside source audio, transcript, waveform, fact cards and verification panel.
Clicking a source-supported evidence citation starts playback at its transcript interval in the scripted synthetic browser workflow.
The actual local waveform endpoint returns bounded peaks tied to the ingested source digest.
limitations: The browser visual workflow used deterministic synthetic waveform peaks; source binding was independently checked against the actual API endpoint using generated PCM WAV data.
The audio test provider is a scripted non-ASR fixture; no speech recognition or clinical accuracy was tested.
The compressed upload Playwright case was skipped because PyAV is unavailable locally.
Independent clinician usability and clinical validation remain unperformed; clinical release is unauthorized.
